name: alembic-wasm
description: Comprehensive WebAssembly bindings and TypeScript SDK for Alembic (.abc) read/write with Three.js loader and exporter

scripts.build:wasm: xmake f -P . -p wasm -a wasm32 -m release -y && xmake build -P . alembic_wasm
scripts.build:ts: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { fs.mkdirSync('dist/wasm/generated', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('src/wasm/generated', 'dist/wasm/generated', { recursive: true }); })"
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
